errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Брой автомобили“, показваща линейна скала, започваща от 0 и достигаща до 3 500 000, с интервали от 500 000.
errors.evidence: This sentence describes the single vertical axis as if it applies to all data presented in the chart. However, this axis and its scale only apply to the blue bars (absolute numbers). The orange bars represent percentages (values from 2.9 to 22.3) and are not plotted against this scale. By failing to mention that the axis only corresponds to one of the two series, the description misrepresents the structure of the chart.
The description does not explicitly state that this is a grouped bar chart. The prompt requires describing how grouping is organized if present.
The description omits the label for the horizontal axis, which is "Axis Title".
